library(ggeasy)

## Raw data   
* Vannmiljø data   

### dat_1: Original data  

```{r}

# raw data
dat_1 <- read_excel("../data/vm_okokyst_oxygen_2022-2024.xlsx", guess_max = 60000)  

# station metadata
dat_station_metadata <- read_excel("../data/vm_okokyst_ctd_stations.xlsx") |>  
  rename(Vannforekomst_id = `Vannforekomst ID`)

```

### dat_2: Add water body ID and time   
```{r}

dat_2 <- dat_1 |> 
  left_join(
    dat_station_metadata |>  select(Vannlokalitetskode, Vannforekomst_id, Klassifiseres), 
    by = join_by(Vannlokalitet_kode==Vannlokalitetskode), relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    time = ymd_hms(Tid_provetak),
    year = year(time),
    month = month(time)
  )

```

### Data on station level  
* defines 'Vannlokalitet_kode_sel' using in filtering below (dat_3)
```{r}

dat_stations_1 <- dat_2 |>
  group_by(Vannlokalitet_kode, Vannlokalitetsnavn) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_years = length(unique(year)),
    n_times = length(unique(time)),
    max_depth_station = max(Nedre_dyp))

dat_stations <- dat_stations_1 |> 
  left_join(
    dat_station_metadata |>  select(Vannlokalitetskode, Vannforekomst_id, Klassifiseres), 
    by = join_by(Vannlokalitet_kode==Vannlokalitetskode), relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) 

table(dat_stations$n_years)
# table(dat_stations$max_depth_station)

dat_stations_sel <- dat_stations |> 
  filter(n_years >= 3 & max_depth_station >= 50)

# Useddin later filtering  
Vannlokalitet_kode_sel <- pull(dat_stations_sel, Vannlokalitet_kode)

```

### Data on water body level  
```{r}

dat_vannforekomst <- dat_stations_sel |> 
  group_by(Vannforekomst_id) |> 
  summarize(
    n_stations = n(),
    Vannlokalitetsnavn = paste(Vannlokalitetsnavn, collapse = "; "))

table(dat_vannforekomst$n_stations)

```


### dat_3: Filter data by station   
* Station should have 3 years of data and not be a ferrybox station (>4 meter depth)   
```{r}

dat_3 <- dat_2 |> 
  filter(Vannlokalitet_kode %in% Vannlokalitet_kode_sel) |> 
  mutate(
    region = substr(Vannforekomst_id, 1, 2)
  )

xtabs(~paste(Vannlokalitet_kode, Vannlokalitetsnavn) + region, dat_3 )

```

### Sample metadata  
```{r}

dat_sample <- dat_3 |>
  group_by(Vannlokalitet_kode, year, time) |> 
  summarise(
    n_depths = length(unique(Nedre_dyp)),
    max_depth = max(Nedre_dyp), 
    min_oxygen = min(Verdi), 
    .groups = "drop"
    ) |> 
  group_by(Vannlokalitet_kode) |> 
  mutate(
    sample_i = 1:length(time),
    max_depth_st = max(max_depth), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  group_by(Vannlokalitet_kode, year) |> 
  mutate(
    sample_iy = 1:length(time), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    max_depth_relative = max_depth/max_depth_st
  )
  
```

### Sample metadata: plots 1  
* X axis = sample occasion  
```{r}

# max depth  
ggplot(dat_sample, aes(sample_i, Vannlokalitet_kode, fill = max_depth)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Maximum depth")

# relative max depth (as fraction of max depth per station)  
ggplot(dat_sample, aes(sample_i, Vannlokalitet_kode, fill = max_depth_relative)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Relative maximum depth (as fraction of max. station depth)")  

# minimum oxygen
ggplot(dat_sample, aes(sample_i, Vannlokalitet_kode, fill = min_oxygen)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Minimum oxygen")

```

### Sample metadata: plots 2  
* X axis = time

```{r}

ggplot(dat_sample, aes(time, Vannlokalitet_kode, fill = min_oxygen)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", direction = -1)

```

### dat_4: Add sample metadata to data  

```{r}

dat_4 <- dat_3 |> 
  left_join(
    dat_sample, by = join_by(Vannlokalitet_kode, time, year))

```

### Annual deep water oxygen minima  
```{r}

rel_depth_threshold <- 0.8

dat_ox_annual <- dat_4 |> 
  filter(
    max_depth_relative >= rel_depth_threshold) %>% # xtabs(~Vannlokalitetsnavn, .)
  group_by(
    Vannlokalitetsnavn, year) |>
  summarise(
    min_ox_annual = min(Verdi)
    )

```
## Norskehavet Nord - find correct data        
* Problem: table 14 in the 2024 report gives means over much more than 3 years (2013-2024 for one station)  
* Below, we try recalculated values from raw data, but these appear to high  
* Then we try t digitize figure 19 in report  

### From raw data          
* Compare with figure 19 in 2024 report  
* Seems to be too high compared to the graph  
```{r}

# dat_stations |> 
#   arrange(Vannlokalitet_kode) |> 
#   pull(Vannlokalitetsnavn) |> dput()

stations_sel <- c("Alvenes", "Setså", 
                  "Skrova", "Tjukkeneset", "Kongsbakkneset",
                  "Straumsfjorden, Bakkland", "Ullsfjorden")

dat_nnord <- dat_ox_annual |> 
  filter(Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel) |> 
  mutate(
    Vannlokalitetsnavn = factor(Vannlokalitetsnavn, levels = stations_sel),
    graph_group = case_when(
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[1:2] ~ 1,
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[3:5] ~ 2,
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[6:7] ~ 3)
  ) 
dat_nnord_mean <- dat_nnord |> 
  group_by(Vannlokalitetsnavn, graph_group) |> 
  summarise(min_ox_mean = mean(min_ox_annual))

```

### Test plot  
```{r}
ggplot(dat_nnord, aes(year, min_ox_annual, color = Vannlokalitetsnavn)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(data = dat_nnord_mean, 
             aes(yintercept = min_ox_mean, color = Vannlokalitetsnavn),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(graph_group), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")
```

### Digitized from graph 
* Figure 19 in report  
```{r}
nnord_lookup_stations <- tribble(
  ~station_graph, ~Vannlokalitetsnavn, ~station, 
  "VT81 - Alvenes", "Alvenes", "VT81 Alvenes",
  "VT82 - Setså", "Setså", "VT82 Setså",
  "VT29 - Skrova", "Skrova", "VT29 Skrova",
  "VT28 - Tjukeneset", "Tjukkeneset", "VT28 Tjukkeneset",
  "VT43 - Kongsbakkeneset", "Kongsbakkneset", "VT43 Kongsbakkneset",
  "VR54 - Straumsfjorden", "Straumsfjorden, Bakkland", "VR54 Straumsfjorden",
  "VR58 - Ullsfjorden", "Ullsfjorden", "VR58 Ullsfjorden"
)

dat_nnord_from_graph <-read_csv(
  "../data/okokyst_oxygen_norskehavet_nord_digitized.csv") |> 
  rename(
    station_graph = station) |> 
  left_join(
    nnord_lookup_stations) |> # str()
  rename(
    min_ox_annual = oxygen_ml_l) |> 
  mutate(
    Vannlokalitetsnavn = factor(Vannlokalitetsnavn, levels = stations_sel),
    graph_group = case_when(
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[1:2] ~ 1,
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[3:5] ~ 2,
      Vannlokalitetsnavn %in% stations_sel[6:7] ~ 3)
  )

```


### Test plot  
* Looks good  
```{r}
ggplot(dat_nnord_from_graph, aes(year, min_ox_annual, color = Vannlokalitetsnavn)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(graph_group), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")

```

### Test plot, values from raw data added   
* raw data = starts ofr years 2022-2024  
```{r}
ggplot(dat_nnord_from_graph, aes(year, min_ox_annual, color = Vannlokalitetsnavn)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = dat_nnord, shape = 8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(graph_group), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")

```

### Mean values 2022-2024  
* 
```{r}
dat_nnord_from_graph_mean <- dat_nnord_from_graph |> 
  filter(
    year %in% 2022:2024) |> 
  group_by(
    station) |> 
  summarise(
    oxygen_ml_l_new = mean(min_ox_annual)
  )
```


## Summary data from report tables  

### Data (dat_rapp_1) 
* Need only 2024 reports, since they report summary numbers based on the yeasr 2022-2024 - which fits well here    
* Extracted using MS Copilot  
* After that, several corrections done for Inner Oslofjord categorization   
   - Dk1 changed from "god" to "moderat" several others changed to "dårlig"/"meget dårlig"  
* Note: except for 

```{r}

Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "Norwegian_Norway.utf8")
dat_rapp_1 <- read_csv("../data/okokyst_oxygen_classification_2022-2024.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    oxygen_nEQR = case_when(
      region %in% c("Barentshavet","Indre Oslofjord") ~ oxygen_nEQR,
      TRUE ~ NA)
  )

```

### Fix for Norskehavet nord (dat_rapp_2)  
```{r}

# dat_rapp_2 |> head(12) |> tail(7)

dat_rapp_2 <- dat_rapp_1 |> 
  left_join(dat_nnord_from_graph_mean, by = join_by(station))

# for check
dat_rapp_2 |>
  filter(region %in% "Norskehavet Nord") |> 
  select(station, oxygen_ml_l, oxygen_ml_l_new)

```

### Fix for Norskehavet nord (dat_rapp_3)  

```{r}
dat_rapp_3 <- dat_rapp_2 |>
  mutate(
    # set oxygen_ml_l to oxygen_ml_l_new for rows with new station values
    oxygen_ml_l = case_when(
      !is.na(oxygen_ml_l_new) ~ oxygen_ml_l_new,
      is.na(oxygen_ml_l_new) ~ oxygen_ml_l)
  ) |> 
  # remove oxygen_ml_l_new
  select(-oxygen_ml_l_new)

```

### Plot oxygen concentration  
```{r}

dat_rapp_3 |> 
  arrange(oxygen_ml_l) |> 
  mutate(
    x = paste(region, station),
    x = fct_inorder(x)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x, oxygen_ml_l, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5)) +
  coord_flip()

```

### Plot nEQR  
```{r}

ggplot(dat_rapp_3, aes(paste(region, station), oxygen_nEQR, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0,1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8), linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip()

```

### Plot nEQR vs concentration   
```{r}

ggplot(dat_rapp_3, aes(oxygen_ml_l, oxygen_nEQR, color = status)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0,1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8), linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_abline(intercept = -0.1, slope = 0.2, color = "brown")
  geom_segment(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 1.5, yend = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(x = 1.5, y = 0.2, xend = 5.5, yend = 1)

```

## dat_rapp: Calculate missing nEQR  
```{r}

dat_rapp <- dat_rapp_3 |> 
  mutate(
    oxygen_nEQR = case_when(
      !is.na(oxygen_nEQR) ~ oxygen_nEQR,
      oxygen_ml_l >= 5.5 ~ 1,
      oxygen_ml_l >= 1.5 ~ -0.1 + 0.2*oxygen_ml_l,
      oxygen_ml_l >= 0 ~ 0.2/1.5*oxygen_ml_l,
      oxygen_ml_l < 0 ~ 0)
  )
```

### Plot nEQR vs concentration   
```{r}

ggplot(dat_rapp, aes(oxygen_ml_l, oxygen_nEQR, color = status)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0,1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8), linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_abline(intercept = -0.1, slope = 0.2, color = "brown")
  geom_segment(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 1.5, yend = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(x = 1.5, y = 0.2, xend = 5.5, yend = 1)

```

## Find national mean  

### Raw mean (equal weight to each station)  
* Inner Oslo fjord has more than two times the weight of Barentshavet  

```{r}
# raw mean
mod1 <- lm(oxygen_nEQR ~ 1, data = dat_rapp)
summary(mod1)$coef

table(dat_rapp$region)  

```

### Marginal mean - equal weight to each ecoregion    
* Inner Oslo fjord and Barentshavet have equal weight
```{r}

# mean putting equal weight on ecoregions
mod2 <- lm(oxygen_nEQR ~ region, data = dat_rapp)
emmeans(mod2, ~1)


```
